tool_input.query:
SELECT c.code, c.name,
       SUM(ss.fail_count) AS total_fail,
       SUM(ss.enrollment_count) AS total_students,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ss.fail_count) / NULLIF(SUM(ss.enrollment_count),0), 2) AS fail_rate_percent
FROM courses c
JOIN vw_section_stats ss ON ss.course_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.code, c.name
HAVING SUM(ss.enrollment_count) >= 5
ORDER BY fail_rate_percent DESC, total_fail DESC
LIMIT 3;
